title: I spent a month making the cozy game I’ve always wanted: Animal Crossing vibes with RuneScape-level grinding! Coming to iOS & Steam)
author: javiergame4
selftext:
Hey everyone! I spent the last month building **Cozy Animals**, a game inspired by Animal Crossing, Stardew Valley, and RuneScape’s skill progression, with the help of AI! Used Claude sonnet mostly for everything.

It’s a cozy life sim with **10+ skills, 100+ hours of content, tons of quests, unlockable cosmetics, house customization, minigames, and optional 4-player co-op.** 

You can grind skills, explore different zones, and unlock rewards at your own pace.

It’s coming to **iOS (free-to-play) and Steam ($9.99 Early Access)**. I just submitted the iOS version for App Store review!

I’m also looking for playtesters to help find bugs and give feedback before launch.

Would love to hear what you guys think! 🐾

Discord link: https://discord.gg/CUdxAbqzv
